examples.ar: رَأَى الأَطْفَالُ هِلَالَ الشَّهْرِ الجَدِيدِ فَبَدَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ البَهْجَةُ.
examples.en: The children saw the crescent of the new month, and joy appeared on them.

examples.ar: ذَٰلِكَ الْكِتَابُ لَا رَيْبَ ۛ فِيهِ ۛ هُدًى لِّلْمُتَّقِينَ.
examples.en: This is the Book about which there is no doubt, a guidance for those conscious of God.

examples.ar: أَعْشَقُ القِرَاءَةَ فِي هُدُوءِ اللَّيْلِ الصَّافِي.
examples.en: I adore reading in the calmness of the clear night.

examples.ar: الْهَوَاءُ النَّقِيُّ عُنْصُرٌ أَسَاسِيٌّ لِصِحَّةِ الجَسَدِ البَشَرِيِّ.
examples.en: Clean air is an essential element for the health of the human body.
Give gifts to one another, you will love one another.

examples.ar: أَبْدَى الطُّلَّابُ هِمَّةً عَالِيَةً فِي تَنْظِيفِ سَاحَةِ المَدْرَسَةِ.
examples.en: The students showed high determination in cleaning the schoolyard.
